instructions.description: Stand between two dumbbells and lift them with a controlled hinge.
Walk forward with short steady steps and relaxed shoulders.
Keep the trunk upright and the weights from swinging.
Set the weights down with a controlled hinge.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Farmer Carry — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Farmer Carry — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.
